strings.ending.ark.title: Ark — New World Landing
strings.ending.ark.blurb: The Qingniao breaks atmosphere. Green horizons. Generations of hydroponics become soil. The ark has landed.
strings.ending.wanderer.title: Wanderer — Never Land
strings.ending.wanderer.blurb: Vote passed: keep flying. Earth is a memory; the void is home.
strings.ending.fusion.title: Fusion — We Are Many
strings.ending.fusion.blurb: Alien symbionts woven into crew DNA. We are no longer alone — nor purely human.
strings.ending.extinction.title: Extinction — The Last Breath
strings.ending.extinction.blurb: Oxygen alarms fall silent. Bays wilt. The ship drifts, a tomb of good intentions.
strings.ending.lookback.title: Lookback — Earth's Echo
strings.ending.lookback.blurb: A signal from Sol — late, distorted. Earth still speaks, but cannot save them.
strings.ending.void_rebirth.title: Void Rebirth — The Garden of Spores
strings.ending.void_rebirth.blurb: Spore gardens bloom in the corridors. The ship becomes a seed pod for something new.
strings.ending.last_human.title: Last Human — The Final Stand
strings.ending.last_human.blurb: Void contact confirmed — hostile. Last stand at the airlock.
strings.ending.none.title: Voyage Continues…
strings.ending.none.blurb: The voyage continues under your watch.
